control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the line tracker reads below 70 %, drive forward at 40 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left, else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Get through the tunnel to the far side.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker's brightness is below 70 %

branches.outcome: the line tracker is dark (black line, below 70 %): drive forward at 40 %

branches.reason: followLine is reached only when the line tracker already reads not black (D1.else), and the same reading can't be black a moment later in the same frame: the left curve never runs.

scenarios.coded_response: The line tracker reads below 70 %, so it drives straight forward at 40 % again and again, along the line into and through the tunnel.
scenarios.initial_condition: On a line that runs straight through a tunnel, the robot starts on the line before the tunnel, facing along it.
scenarios.trigger: The program starts and the line tracker reads black.
scenarios.title: Gets through the tunnel
assumptions: There is a line through the tunnel for it to drive along.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives through the tunnel to the far side.

scenarios.coded_response: It calls followLine and, not seeing black, curves right.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot stands off any line on a plain floor, with nothing ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker reads brighter than 70 % and no obstacle is ahead.
scenarios.title: Off the line, it curves right

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the obstacle is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot stands off any line with an obstacle ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker reads brighter than 70 % and an obstacle is ahead.
scenarios.title: Off the line, stops at an obstacle

uncertainties: Your program reads the line tracker's brightness, not a light sensor: the dim light inside a tunnel changes nothing it reads, so it gets through only by driving forward on a line that runs through the tunnel.
You didn't say what it should do when it is not on a line, or when it meets an obstacle.
The left curve can never run: followLine is reached only when the line tracker already reads not black, so it can't read black a moment later.
